_note: Canonical premium/pro service catalog for cti-expert. Managed by apikeys.py (/apikeys). Keys resolve env-var first, then the skill-root .env. Keyless/free mode always works without any of these; premium keys are strictly additive. Never commit .env.

services.name: Shodan
services.unlocks: /webpivot: reverse favicon mmh3 hash -> hosts; /cert-pivot: reverse TLS cert fingerprint -> hosts; host/service intelligence

services.name: Censys
services.unlocks: /webpivot: reverse favicon MD5 -> hosts; /cert-pivot: cert fingerprint_sha256 -> hosts; certificate + host search

services.name: FOFA
services.unlocks: /webpivot: reverse favicon icon_hash + tracker body -> hosts; IP reverse

services.name: SecurityTrails
services.unlocks: /webpivot + /dns-history: passive DNS, subdomains, WHOIS + DNS history

services.name: urlscan.io PRO
services.unlocks: /webpivot + /scam-check: authenticated DOM content search, related domains/IPs, submit scans

services.name: Quake (360)
services.unlocks: /webpivot + /icp: independent CN cyberspace index — favicon mmh3, body/ICP-string search -> hosts Shodan and FOFA miss

services.name: ZoomEye
services.unlocks: /webpivot + /cert-pivot: reverse favicon iconhash (mmh3) -> hosts; CN-weighted asset search (also drives the kunyu console)

services.name: DNSLytics
services.unlocks: /webpivot: reverse AdSense (ca-pub-) / legacy GA (UA-) ID -> sibling domains

services.name: WhoisXML
services.unlocks: /webpivot --whois + /whois: current + historic WHOIS, reverse-WHOIS by email/name

services.name: SSLMate CertSpotter
services.unlocks: /cert-history + /webpivot: higher-rate CT lookups (optional; crt.sh is free/keyless)

services.name: ZoneCruncher / zetalytics
services.unlocks: /webpivot + /dns-history: liveDNS, reverse-email -> domains registered by an email

services.name: ChongLuaDao
services.unlocks: /scam-check + /breach-deep: Vietnamese phishing/scam + breach feed; /email-hygiene: disposable/burner email detection

services.name: Intelligence X (IntelX)
services.unlocks: /breach-deep + darknet search: dark-web, paste, and leak selectors

services.name: Bright Data SERP
services.unlocks: /dork-sweep: SerpAPI alternative for dork automation + residential SERP

services.name: Blockchair
services.unlocks: /crypto-balance + /webpivot --wallets: full balance + lifetime received/sent across BTC/ETH/LTC/BCH/DOGE/DASH/ZEC
